# Native UI Automation dependencies

- FlaUI.Core and FlaUI.UIA3 5.0.0: https://github.com/FlaUI/FlaUI, MIT license in `FlaUI-LICENSE.txt`.
- Interop.UIAutomationClient 10.19041.0: https://github.com/Roemer/UIAutomation-Interop, license in `UIAutomation-Interop-LICENSE.txt`.

The isolated worker uses these open-source Windows UI Automation clients. It does not depend on Avalonia's commercial developer-tools UI or its authorization mechanism.
